rules.statement: A transferee who has been in possession of property transferred for over the time fixed for acquisition of title by prescription can set up a title by prescription, unless notice or an action to set aside the contract is received before such possession.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is only however, on receiving notice that the contract has been induced by fraud that the constructive trust arises. Such a contract is voidable and not altogether void, and it is from the time that the transferor makes up his mind to impeach the contract that the transferee must hold the property for the benefit of the transferor. In the present case no notice appears to have been given, but the institution of the action might be regarded as such notice."
